dimensions.mission: Make an existing research run durably finish and release its operational profile; no alpha or new research.
dimensions.flexibility_and_history: Preserve source IDs, scientific slots, epochs, result/draft/assessment bytes and exposure. Completion remains derived from the native aggregate.
dimensions.context_efficiency: One native synthetic vertical, short adversarial controls and existing direct-consumer checks; no new framework or local full CI.
dimensions.research_truth: Historical source-epoch agreement permits aggregation of a fully completed chain only; not current scientific qualification. UNKNOWN remains explicit.
dimensions.owner_operability: Same forge-run entry/persist; missing child starts, saved own draft resumes, bound completed child finishes. No artificial owner-stop.
dimensions.execution_to_cashflow: Avoid false operational OPEN and repeated work without promoting a hypothesis or creating execution authority.
dimensions.monitoring_and_recovery: Before real receipt append, code revert is ordinary. After append prefer forward repair; an older reader can again fail to derive child completion, so preserve receipt and revalidate instead of rewriting history.
dimensions.build_vs_buy: Reuse ResearchStore, ladder transitions, source slots/journals and native lifecycle owner. No dependency, schema, scheduler, provider or service.
dimensions.security: No credentials or market/provider access; foreign parent/focus/market/slot/journal/time do not prove completion.
dimensions.red_team: An owner-final word or cap change alone cannot complete a pending child or erase spend. Native persist repeat and scientific-ledger equality are checked. Orphan recovery requires the parent selected by the aggregate; a draft cannot attest its own lineage.

capability_radar.watch: Only an evidenced missing or conflicting frozen lineage; no automatic repair, new science or platform work.

recovery: Keep every scientific artifact and receipt. Revert code before operational append; after append use forward repair and exact cold readback. Never owner-stop or edit history to simulate completion.
